description: This unique, light weight 4 drawer chest is a simple, beautiful piece of furniture and décor crafted from tough, durable, spun plant fiber cord. Woven on kiln dried wood frames, it's a great size for a tall end table or nightstand. The plant fiber absorbs dye beautifully, creating appealing, richly colorful home furnishings. As the 21st century progresses, people seem to be shopping for beauty and practicality in equal measure. If you are looking for furniture that is strong and durable, rustically beautiful, and surprisingly light weight, this piece is a great place to start. Note the low prices and excellent quality; this woven fiber furniture and accessories provide exceptional value.
